The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses According to the guidelines issued by the National Health Mission (NHM), Madhy a Pradesh (Letter No. NHM/1099/2024-MH-NHM, Bhopal, Dated 21/09/2026), he re are the key details for conducting the bid/procurement of Cuvette-based Di gital Hemoglobinometers (DHB) through the GeM portal: 1. Procurement Objectives & Scope (Decentralized Procuremen t) Objective: To ensure the availability of 1 Digital Hemoglobinometer ( DHB) device per ANM based on the registered ANMS count in the ANMOL S oftware, along with a proportional quantity of Cuvettes. Payment Terms: This is an all-inclusive model. No separate payment will be made for Cuvettes, the corresponding DHB devices, or other associated accessories like lancets. Financial Source: The entire expenditure for this decentralized procurem ent must be met and booked under the approved allocations of the 15th F inance Commission via e-Bitt Pravah. 2. Technical Specifications (Mandatory Standards for Bidding) Bids must strictly comply with the guidelines set by the Government of India an d the State Level Technical Committee: Working Principle: Absorbance Photometry Dual Wavelength. Hb Estimation Range: 0–25 gm/dl.

Blood Sample Volume: <10–50 µl (one full drop of capillary or venous w hole blood). Measuring Time: Less than 1 minute. Calibration: Auto/self-calibration and code-free calibration (factory-calibr ated as per International Council for Standardization in Haematology - ICS H guidelines). Accuracy & Validation: Sensitivity >90%, Specificity >90%, and bias <0. 5 gm/dl. Performance accuracy must be corroborated/published in at least two peer-reviewed index journals based on community-based studies in tw o different Indian settings by independent teams. Memory & Data Transfer: Essential storage of up to 1,000 test results w ith date and time stamps; USB cable and Bluetooth connectivity for data tr ansfer to printers and PCs. Power Requirements: Rechargeable Lithium-ion battery (capable of perf orming 500 tests when fully charged) along with a direct AC adapter/charg er. A clear instruction stating "Charge device within 60 days of delivery" m ust be printed on the outer packaging. Cuvettes & Consumables: Cuvettes must have a minimum shelf life of 2 years and an open-vial stability of at least 6 months. Each cuvette pack m ust contain 50 cuvettes along with an equal number of single-use, auto-dis abled 23-gauge safety lancets. Certifications: CDSCO approved, USA FDA / European CE (Notified Body) / BIS compliant, ISO13485 certified, and IEC60601 for electrical safety. A b atch testing and calibration report from a NABL-accredited lab must be pro vided at the time of supply. Warranty & Support: 3 years for the device and 2 years for cuvettes fr om the manufacturing date. There must be a provision for immediate stan dby/replacement and local service personnel in every district to ensure uni nterrupted service. 3. District-Level Purchase Committee & Evaluation A District-Level Purchase Committee headed by the Chief Medical and Heal th Officer (CMHO) must include a District Hospital Pathologist and an MD -PSM/MPH/PGDPHM Public Health Expert as technical members. Prior to purchase, the committee may require a technical demonstration or assess the device by testing at least 10 samples against a calibrated auto mated hematology analyzer as a reference method. Formal approval must be obtained from the District Collector cum Chair man, District Health Society. 4. Additional Requirement:- Cuvette-based Digital Hemoglobinometer with (1000 Cuvettes & 1000 Lancets per Unit) We have specified the requirements for the Cuvette-based Digital Hemoglobinometer in the ATC (Additional Terms & Conditions) .
